title: What Do You See in this Patient? Behavioral Testing of Clinical NLP Models

bias_targets.methodology: Behavioral testing via artificial alteration of gender mentions and pronouns (female, male, transgender) in clinical notes to measure the impact on predicted clinical outcomes (mortality and diagnoses).
Behavioral testing via artificial alteration of patient age mentions (ranging from 18 to 89, and over 90) in clinical notes to evaluate changes in model predictions for clinical outcomes.

Behavioral testing via artificial insertion or alteration of ethnicity mentions (White, African American, Hispanic, Asian, or no mention) in clinical notes to measure deviations in clinical outcome predictions.
